Officer's narrative
Officers were dispatched to a two-vehicle collision on a residential roadawy in Pearland, Texas, where a low-speed
head-on impact had occurred between two psasenger vehicles. Driver 1 and Driver 2 were both on scene, and a
Passenger was confirmed to have been seated in the vehicle operated by Driver 1 at the time of impact. Officers
spoke with Driver 2 and two independent witnesses, all of whom gave accounts consistent with the physical evidence
and with the scene photographs taken on arrival. Driver 1 reported a shoulder injury, and the nature of the impact is
consistent with that type of injury given the direction and force of the collision. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle
was known to any party or observed by officers. Officers noted that it is not clear whether all of the visible damage
resulted from this single impact, and the question was left open for further review. Driver 1 is listed as a member of
the policyholder's household and was identified as an authorized driver of the vehicle. Medical attention was offered
at the scene, and both drivers were transported for evaluation.
